item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Federal judge lifts nationwide block on mail-in voting restrictions
item.description: A federal judge in Boston on Wednesday lifted a nationwide block on mail-in voting restrictions, temporarily clearing the way for the Trump administration to begin implementing them ahead of the November midterms. U.S. District Judge Indira Talwani granted the Justice Department’s request to reconsider her earlier injunction in the wake of a Supreme Court ruling [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Blue states launch new suit to stop Trump's mail-in voting restrictions
item.description: Democratic-controlled states brought a new lawsuit challenging the Trump administration’s mail-in voting restrictions on Wednesday, hoping they’ll find better success after the Supreme Court ruled they sued prematurely. The high court found the states had no right to sue over the president’s executive order that he signed in the spring. But it left open the possibility that someone [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman hires attorney after Flock camera database error leads to gunpoint stop
item.description: Milwaukee woman Amber Newell retains attorney B'Ivory LaMarr after a Flock camera error led to a gunpoint traffic stop that cost her two jobs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two Zephyrhills teens cause 4 crashes fleeing law enforcement: FHP
item.description: wo Zephyrhills teenagers were jailed after causing four hit-and run crashes in Hillsborough County on Wednesday while fleeing from law enforcement, the Florida Highway Patrol said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Father of US Navy sailor on record-setting deployment released from immigration custody
item.description: The father of a U.S. Navy sailor aboard a record-setting deployment has been released from immigration custody after his arrest in Florida.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Excess belly fat could reveal more about the lifespan of older adults than BMI
item.description: The study found that a larger waist circumference correlates with a higher risk of an early death, but those being overweight based on BMI have a lower risk.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Law meant to protect from surprise medical bills may drive up insurance costs
item.description: A law aimed at making healthcare more affordable may actually be driving up premiums, according to a new Georgetown University study.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Coke Zero Sugar 400 at Daytona: NASCAR's final regular-season race before Cup Series playoffs
item.description: Five drivers are battling for three remaining playoff spots as NASCAR introduces a unique aerodynamic package for Saturday night's race.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] St. Petersburg police officer fired after domestic battery arrest: SPPD
item.description: A St. Petersburg Police Officer was terminated on Tuesday after he was arrested in February for domestic battery against his wife.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Contract terminated: License plate detection systems to be removed from Pasco County: Sheriff
item.description: Pasco County Sheriff Chris Nocco said he is terminating the agreement for license plate detection systems in the county.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FDA approves first-of-its-kind treatment for most common form of pancreatic cancer
item.description: The FDA just approved a first-of-its-kind treatment for the deadliest and most common form of pancreatic cancer — and it nearly doubled survival time in clinical trials.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] UEFA set to end boycott threat after Infantino's failed World Cup investor plan
item.description: European soccer body UEFA is set to formally withdraw its threat to boycott FIFA competitions after receiving assurances Gianni Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan will not be revived.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dolly Parton placed secret song in a time capsule that will be released in 2045
item.description: Dolly Parton has left a special gift for the world to hear, it was revealed after an interview with Jimmy Fallon resurfaced.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Judge dismisses murder charge in fatal shooting of Tampa DJ under Florida’s Stand Your Ground law
item.description: A Hillsborough County judge granted a motion to dismiss a second-degree murder charge against Joel Moreno Cobo on Wednesday morning.

item.description: Investigators are renewing their appeal for information in the disappearance of a 54-year-old man missing since the spring of 2007.
